newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria has 51.04 bln levs Q3 trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria has 51.04 bln levs Q3 trade surplus.

text.p: Bulgaria posted a trade surplus of 51.04 billion levs in the third quarter after a 2.48 billion deficit in the second quarter, updated preliminary customs figures show.
BULGARIA MERCHANDISE TRADE Q3 Q2 Q3'95
Bulgaria's largest turnover in the third quarter of around 151 billion levs was in trade with countries of the European Union, figures show.
The largest importer of Bulgarian goods and services was Germany with 23.1 billion levs.
Russia had the largest share in Bulgaria's imports with 52.4 billion levs in the third quarter.
Bulgaria's exports to the republics of the former Soviet Union totalled 44.6 billion levs, while imports amounted to 57.5 billion levs.
Adjusted trade figures in U.S. dollars are expected be issued by the central bank later this month together with current account data. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
